messages:
lina: quick heads-up — landed API PR that changes /v1/models metadata response (adds 'runtime_hint'). SDK PR depends on it: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/842. Need merge ordering and a coordinator.

mike: @lina can we keep the API change backwards-compatible? SDK is toggling on runtime_hint if present.

lina: it's additive only, but console needs to read it for the new model picker. Console PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/429 (reads runtime_hint).

kevin: CI for sdk PR fails integration tests until console is deployed (header missing). Failing test snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected 200 got 404
GET /models/:id -> missing header X-Redwood-Runtime
```

charlotte: OK — proposed sequence: 1) merge API PR, 2) deploy API canary, 3) merge console + sdk together (console reads new field, sdk tolerates absence), 4) helm bump for runtime chart with new image tag. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

mike: prefer to merge console after API is live in canary so sdk e2e passes. But console needs a small toggle flag (feature.runtimeHint=true) so console doesn't break on regions that haven't deployed API canary.

lina: I can add the flag to console PR today. Suggest we tag PRs with 'merge-order:dep-chain' and hold merges until canary passes for 30m.

sam: FYI runtime helm chart also needs a config change: values.yaml -> runtime.extraEnv: RUNTIME_HINT_ENABLED=true. Helm PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/211. If runtime image isn't bumped, console will see hints but runtime won't act.

kevin: CI note — integration-tests flake when the deployment order is wrong; let's gate with a short checklist in the PR description: API canary green, helm bumped, console feature flag on, sdk e2e green. I'll add the checklist to sdk PR now.

charlotte: I'll coordinate the canary window tomorrow 09:30 PT. @ci-bot can you schedule a canary rollout for api/main at 09:35 PT?

ci-bot: scheduled canary rollout for refs/heads/main (api) at 2026-03-18T16:35:00Z. Notifying #incidents if health < 99% in 15m.

mike: Thanks. I'll watch the e2e and merge console+sdk once canary is healthy. If anything blocks, ping here and we'll pause merges. :thumbsup:

lina: perfect — I'll update console PR with the feature flag and add merge-order labels to all four PRs. Anyone want to take final review on sdk? @kevin?

kevin: I'll do a final pass after the checklist is in.

lina: awesome, closing loop — will post a short rollout plan in the PRs.
